pages.text: In create, $(thing)dried kelp$() is used as the base for many machines, however, in the world of $(#6A2)TerraFirmaCraft$() dried algae is much rarer, and as such it would $(italic)quickly$() become a bottleneck in every factory.$(br)  This is why, in $(#f80051)TerraFirmaNautics$(), dried kelp's function has been replaced by $(l:mechanics/leather_making)leather$().
Tunnels, funnels, conveyor belts and spouts have all had their recipes adapted to use leather instead of dried kelp.
